notes.title: September 2021 Update
notes.content:
Hello! 

We're currently in the process of remaking "blocks" in a different game engine to help with ease of updates, but for now we've just pushed a small patch to help with gameplay features. For any questions or feedback for the game, be sure to join our Discord ( https://discord.com/invite/Rn5es3c ) and let us know your thoughts!

notes.title: Updating Error With Launching Game
notes.content: We recently discovered an error with the game that would occur with boot-up and the game would simply boot into a black screen. This is an error that is related to the engine used to build this game, Construct 2, and often happens due to the software it uses, node.js. Unfortunately there appears to be no quick fix to the error, but if it does occur again, we ask you to please contact us using the store page for the game.
